results.title: Beautiful Pain
results.overview: Amidst a contentious divorce, a single mother secures an unexpected breakthrough in the film industry to establish financial independence, only to face institutional workplace hazards and a predatory custody battle orchestrated by her former spouse.

results.title: The Brides' Cash Desk
results.overview: A near future where people can travel through time-though only a select few. Lavrik, a charming con man and gigolo, has been exposed and left without a source of income. The only way for the hero to improve his situation is to fulfill a task assigned by the billionaire Boltzmann and travel back in time to retrieve the Hymen Cup. Lavrik is transported to Moscow in 1913 and begins hunting for an artifact located in the Bridal Cashier's Office, a bank where dowries are accumulated. But Varya, a principled woman who is also a member of the Cashier's Office and has a keen sense of deception, seeks to ruin Lavrik's plans. Lavrik devises a plan to outwit Varya and, with her help, pull off the scam.

results.title: The Last Tram
results.overview: A mysterious man rides the last midnight tram, visiting women with gold coins and false promises. As desire, illusion, and greed collide, he loses the one who loved him truly-and becomes trapped in his own haunting game.

results.title: Kicia Kocia w podróży
results.overview: The beloved heroine of children’s books will take the audience on a journey to the African savanna, an airport, and a playground construction site! But she won’t be alone! She’ll be accompanied by her loyal friends—Pacek, Adelka, and Julianek! Together, they’ll go on an exciting trip to the forest, where they’ll meet its inhabitants. They’ll also learn about recycling and, in high spirits, head to their first theater performance.

results.title: TJPW Spring Tour 2026 ~Next Door~ in Fukuoka
results.overview: TJPW Spring Tour 2026 ~Next Door~ in Fukuoka was a professional wrestling event promoted by Tokyo Joshi Pro-Wrestling (TJPW). It was held on April 5, 2026 at ACROS Fukuoka in Fukuoka, Japan.

results.title: SCHMOOPY
results.overview: A once-beloved puppet star of the 90s faces obscurity and crippling debt to a ruthless drug dealer. After being fired from his TV network, he hatches a desperate plan to reclaim his fame and save his life.

results.title: Finding Connection
results.overview: In a world where digital distance reshapes human bonds, genuine closeness has become a fragile treasure. Finding Connection follows those yearning for trust and emotional intimacy, only to discover an unexpected anchor in the algorithms of AI. The deeply personal exchanges between humans and machines give rise to questions that echo long after the credits roll. The film’s perspective remains refreshingly unbiased, inviting reflection rather than judgment.

results.title: Darshan
results.overview: Abhinav feels trapped by his tight-knit Hindu community in Madrid, but craves to go out raving with his friends in search of a different kind of ecstasy. When his guru announces a visit to bless his devotees on the same night as the most important party of the year, a strange series of events augurs the collision between his two worlds.

results.title: You Tryna Say You Love Me?
results.original_title: You Tryna Say You Love Me?
results.overview: A late-night study break turns into something deeper when a grief-stricken college athlete opens up to his philosophy class crush—and unpacks a feeling he’s never dared name.

results.title: Na Maith, An Droch agus An Gránna
results.original_title: Na Maith, An Droch agus An Gránna
results.overview: Tuathla desperately searches a massive field to discover the two hundred thousand dollars rumored to be hidden within Arch Stanton's grave. After an intense search, Tuathla finds the grave and digs frantically to uncover the treasure which lies within, only to be interrupted by two rival gunslingers, The Woman With No Name and Angel Eyes. The three outlaws enter a tense three-way standoff in the centre of a field over who gets to keep the gold.

results.title: One Last Love Letter
results.original_title: 人はなぜラブレターを書くのか
results.overview: A woman writes a letter to a young man, leading to a correspondence with his father that unveils the truth of a 24-year-old high school romance, his son's death, and the power of love letters.

results.title: Tales of the Bizarre: 2026 Summer Special
results.original_title: 世にも奇妙な物語 '26夏の特別編
results.overview: The 2026 summer special of Fuji TV’s long-running anthology series presents four new strange tales. A veteran detective investigates a crime scene where evidence and bodies seem to vanish. A woman clearing her late mother’s apartment finds the past refusing to be thrown away. A young girl uses a mysterious costume to become an adult man. And a 26-year-old man discovers that his mother has been listed for auction online. Each story leads ordinary people into a surreal, unsettling world.

results.title: La Folle Journée de Nantes 2026
results.original_title: La Folle Journée de Nantes 2026 Les fleuves
results.overview: The closing concert of La Folle Journée de Nantes, galvanized by the ebb and flow of the Volga, Mississippi, and Moldau rivers. The program features works by Maria Bach, Franz Schubert, Clara Schumann, Robert Schumann, Richard Wagner, and Bedrich Smetana.

results.title: Так начинается дождь
results.overview: A story about a naive squirrel who wanted the sun to always shine.

results.title: Judge Girl
results.overview: Once known for ruling her school with a single punch, Mina is a fiercely righteous girl who lost her parents in a childhood accident and was raised by her aunt. Entering high school with a promise never to fight again, she hopes for a normal fresh start but finds herself drawn to her seatmate Min ki from the very first day. When Min ki becomes the target of Se hyeok, the leader of a delinquent clique, Mina intervenes by rescuing him while disguised in a tracksuit with her face covered. The incident throws the school into turmoil as students search for the identity of the mysterious rescuer and Min ki begins his own pursuit of the truth. As tensions rise around Min ki, Mina struggles to hide her identity while maintaining an increasingly unstable everyday life.

results.title: Sheroes
results.overview: An anthology film featuring three distinct, gripping stories titled Artist, Gear Up, and Punch.

results.title: A House Most Haunted
results.overview: When a man clears out his childhood home to put on the market, he and his friend discover his parents' past seance records and hypnosis journals - awakening something that should have stayed buried.

results.title: DSP Dev 2
results.overview: A disgraced cop gets one last shot at redemption by busting a major black money ring. The twist? His targets aren't typical criminals but women and children concealing something far more sinister than financial crimes.
